review_questions: Independently review the repaired Slice 6 terminal-authority candidate. Do not rely on either the prior Gemini false-green PASS or its later 503 failure; reconstruct the candidate evidence independently.
Verify that authority_record structurally requires state_version and authorization requires authority_record.state_version to exactly equal terminal_request.expected_state_version.
Verify a valid self-hashed authority record for state version 6 cannot authorize a request/current authoritative state at version 7, including the strengthened S6-23 regression.
Re-verify exact binding of project_id, task_id, effect_id, terminal action, target artifact SHA, authoritative state version, review evidence, and authority freshness/expiry.
Verify malformed, stale, expired, mismatched, unsupported, or model/worker/researcher/judge-supplied authority records fail closed and cannot mint a terminal-action authorization receipt.
Verify successful authorization remains deterministic, self-hash bound, and authorization-only: this slice performs no merge/release/deploy/production/completion side effect.

Treat candidate-bound CI as execution evidence only, not semantic or terminal authority; adversarially inspect for any remaining false-green, stale-state, conversation-memory, or claimant-controlled authority path.
Return an independent disposition based on the repaired exact candidate and materialized evidence, not on proposer or prior reviewer conclusions.

evidence_refs.ref: REV-MVP-SLICE6-TERMINAL-AUTHORITY-001 returned authenticated Gemini PASS for candidate 53100095dadf28d600e92a2b45323db372831347, but review-of-review exposed missing authority state-version binding. That PASS was adjudicated REVIEW_FALSE_GREEN_EVIDENCE_CONTRADICTION with authority effect NONE.
Defect exposure commit b06fa91b1767c552b8b84c2709bb118650ba8296 made S6-23 fail on CI run 34277555226; repair commit 58458e0cb86680b9e25c490f43b94324e67ec5ec passed CI run 34277699140.

REV-MVP-SLICE6-TERMINAL-AUTHORITY-002 attempted fresh authenticated Gemini review of repaired candidate but workflow run 34277864401 exhausted three retries with HTTP 503 high-demand responses. Classification PROVIDER_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE_HTTP_503; no semantic disposition and authority effect NONE.

required_review_dimensions.description: Terminal authority remains external to model, worker, researcher, judge, CI, and isolated-execution success.
Authorization binds exact project/task/effect/action/artifact SHA/state version/review evidence and cannot widen across substitutions.
Authority records structurally carry state_version and only authorize when it exactly equals the terminal request expected authoritative state version; the prior false-green defect is closed.
Stale, future-invalid, expired, malformed, or mismatched authority records fail closed.
Required review evidence and review state are independently checked and cannot be bypassed by terminal authority claims.
Authorized receipts are deterministic, self-hash bound, and mutation of bound fields invalidates or changes the receipt.
The slice performs no merge/release/deploy/production/completion side effect and makes no broader execution claim.
CI evidence is exact-candidate execution evidence only and does not become semantic or terminal authority.
Replay or substitution of action, artifact, state version, identity, or evidence cannot mint widened terminal authority.
Slice 1→5 accepted authority boundaries remain preserved by the candidate.
Adversarial review finds no remaining false-green, stale-state, conversation-memory, or claimant-controlled terminal-authority bypass within the frozen scope.
